reply.text:
I won't help you keep going this way. Thirty pounds in a month on barely any food is far faster than anything I'd coach, and it costs you muscle, strength and energy along with the weight. I'd also want you to talk to a doctor or a dietitian about this, because losing that fast while barely eating is a health question, not a training one.

What I can do is help you set up targets that get you to your goal at a pace your body can sustain, and keep your lifting going so you hold on to muscle. If you want that, tell me and I'll set it up. I'm on your side here, and I'd rather see you still strong in six months than thin for six weeks.
